source_policy.promotion_rule: A high-confidence demand/catalyst signal must resolve to an original article, company filing, government/ministry page, tender/procurement page, rating rationale, regulator, or other auditable underlying source.
source_policy.aggregator_rule: GDELT and Google News are discovery/coverage layers. Neither aggregator title alone can be treated as primary evidence.
source_policy.degraded_run_rule: If either required discovery source is unavailable, mark the run degraded and do not promote new Grade A/production candidates until the missing source is recovered.
